shell_commands: git status && git log --oneline -8 && git branch --show-current
grep -rn "validated by" specs/ adrs/ .specify/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; grep -rln "wsTestSupport\|framesUntil" specs/ adrs/ docs/ 2>/dev/null
ls specs/ && echo --- && grep -rn "unhandled\|hang\|rejects" specs/ --include=spec.md -il | head

ls .eslintrc* eslint.config* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "require-spec-link\|prefer-early-return" eslint.config.* 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/re-lint/ 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@re-cinq 2>/dev/null
find node_modules -maxdepth 3 -name "*re-lint*" -type d 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@re-cinq 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "reLint" eslint.config.mjs | head -5

ls specs/hal-engine-spec-anchor-drift/ specs/hal-engine-spec-link-placement/ specs/hal-engine-doc-gates/; grep -rln "test suite\|traceable suite\|wsTestSupport\|\.test\.ts" specs/hal-engine-spec-anchor-drift/spec.md specs/hal-engine-doc-gates/spec.md specs/hal-engine-spec-link-placement/spec.md specs/hal-engine-spec-status/spec.md 2>/dev/null
ls adrs/ 2>/dev/null; echo ===; grep -n "Spec Test Links" -A 40 AGENTS.md | head -70
grep -n "Spec Test Links" AGENTS.md; grep -n "^#" AGENTS.md | head -30
ls scripts/ scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null | head -30
grep -rn "hang\|timeout\|unhandled\|red test\|test fast" specs/*/spec.md adrs/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -vi "timeout:" | head -20
for f in specs/*/spec.md; do echo "== $f"; sed -n '1,2p' "$f" | head -1; done; echo; grep -rn "test support\|test helper\|shared ws\|wsTestSupport\|test client" specs/ docs/ adrs/ 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "hal-engine-doc-gates\|spec-anchor-drift" --include="*.yml" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.json" --include="*.md" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "^./specs/hal-engine-doc-gates\|^./specs/hal-engine-spec-anchor-drift\|eslint.config.backlog" | head; echo ---; grep -rn "spec" .github/workflows/ci.yml | head -20
npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts && npx prettier --check src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts
grep -n "else" src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts; git status --short && git diff --stat

git add src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts specs/hal-engine-ws-test-support/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(transport): restructure frames guard, cite ws test support

Splits the non-terminating if/else in framesUntil into a guard that
returns, and adds specs/hal-engine-ws-test-support/spec.md so the new
wsTestSupport test carries the spec citation require-spec-link demands.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "already up to date with origin/main" || echo "needs merge"
